topic: Chimborazo farthest point from Earth's centre
hook: Your climb up Chimborazo ends farther from Earth's centre than Everest.
title: This Mountain Beats Everest In One Way
description:
Ecuador's Chimborazo is not the highest mountain above sea level, but its summit is the point on Earth's surface farthest from the planet's centre. Earth bulges at the equator, and Chimborazo sits right near it.

#Shorts #Geography #Facts
